This tale of yours deserves more love. Your Nobody feels more like an actual individual who thinks and acts than the usual walking, talking, incomprehensible enigma.
So yeah, for the great quality of this piece I gave it an upvote, hope it'll get a hundred more!

I was not familiar with the rules behind tagging stuff as goi-format. I assumed only the format made originality can be tagged as such for it was made by the author of the GOI.

Yeah, I'll note the spacing for future articles. I kept it in for it helps to make it look like Nobody wrote it in a rush, though depends on content.

item.content:encoded:
I feel this could very easily be tagged as goi-format rather than tale, given that it fills the same narrative role and the rules for tagging GoI formats are laxer.

Additionally, bullet points fuck with the linespacing on Nobody formats too much. I recommend something like what I did in Black As Night, using a text character at the start of the "bullet list", to keep proper spacing.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Hello, folks. So I have with me an article about Nobody, which is a cold post.

My main goal was to really dabble in kinda of a new format for Nobody. I didn't enjoy the structure of the original format.

Anyway, this is a tale of Nobody doing a job while taking notes on his activities. I'm not sure what others headcanon about Nobody (I know it varies), but I hope there is some enjoyment you can take out of this.

P.S. Lefty is a concept from the Russian branch of SCP. I feel Nobody would know Lefty since both share a similar vibe.
